reason: The cited lines show Lighthouse navigation/snapshot is run against the current Puppeteer page URL, reports are generated/saved, and the Lighthouse-derived output is attached to the response. They do not show arbitrary host code execution. They do not establish that non-public data is accessed, though the audited page could potentially be private depending on surrounding context. They also do not clearly establish delivery of agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination; navigation to the current page URL may involve network access, but these lines alone do not settle attacker-readability or agent choice. The returned/saved Lighthouse result is derived from a web page, whose content/URL can be attacker-controlled, so UNTRUSTED is supported.
